[CARDINAL]. If you rename the old volume to vola_old and rename your vola_mirror to vola, you will still need to reconnect to it. Like I stated before, ideally you will want to have this umounted and unaccessible for a short time to complete a final sync.
Vol move is your best bet for uninterrupted data moves, but the method you described with snapmirror would work too, and would be the only way to do it with remote [CARDINAL] mode filers/aggrs.
